channel.title: Youth Ka Pakistan (YKP Foundation)
channel.description: Skills, mentorship, and youth events from Youth Ka Pakistan — a nationwide nonprofit in Karachi.

item.title: URAAN-E-AI 2026: Pakistan’s Digital Flight lands in Karachi
item.description: On 1 September 2026 at DHA Suffa University, Youth ka Pakistan hosts a national IT and Artificial Intelligence seminar for students, educators, and innovators.

item.title: How mentorship helps young Pakistanis turn talent into a career
item.description: A mentor shortens the distance between potential and a first real opportunity. Here is how Youth ka Pakistan connects students with people who have walked the path.

item.title: Skills that open doors: why practical learning matters for Pakistani youth
item.description: Degrees help, but employers hire people who can do the work. Youth ka Pakistan focuses on free, practical skills young people can use immediately.
